items.chunk: I was wondering if you could…
items.meaning: 不知你能否……；礼貌求助
items.quote: Hello, sir. I was wondering if, maybe, you could help me? Yeah?

items.chunk: be in such a rush to do sth.
items.meaning: 急着做某事
items.quote: but I was just in such a rush to get some medicine for my son, Freddie.

items.meaning: 长话短说；概括经过
items.quote: But long story short, I drove into town, I bought the new medicine with every last nickel in my pocket, and then my car died.

items.meaning: 口袋里的最后一分钱；强调倾其所有
items.quote: I bought the new medicine with every last nickel in my pocket,

items.meaning: 祸不单行
items.quote: I know. When it rains, it pours, right?

items.meaning: 如果你能……；非常委婉的请求
items.quote: Thanks, and I appreciate that, but if you could possibly just spare $5 instead? I'd rather grab a cab than take a chance with my old clunker.

items.meaning: 匀／借给某人一点钱
items.quote: but if you could possibly just spare $5 instead? I'd rather grab a cab than take a chance with my old clunker. Yeah. $5? If you can spare it.

items.meaning: 在某事上冒险／碰运气
items.quote: I'd rather grab a cab than take a chance with my old clunker.

items.meaning: 轻易得到的施舍／钱
items.quote: this is the spot to come for an easy handout.

items.meaning: 究竟在哪儿／怎么会……？；加强惊讶
items.quote: "Grifter"? Where in the world did you learn that word?

items.meaning: 骗某人；口语
items.quote: He's conning you.

items.meaning: 看守收银台／负责收款
items.quote: Come on, Jimmy, just man the till, okay, and I'll just be back in a jiff. Okay?

items.meaning: 马上／一会儿；旧式口语
items.quote: and I'll just be back in a jiff. Okay?

items.meaning: 强者掠夺弱者的世界观；剧情中的比喻
items.quote: There are wolves and sheep in this world, kid. Wolves and sheep. Figure out which one you're gonna be.

items.meaning: 不用管我，你们继续；礼貌让人继续
items.quote: Don't let me interrupt.

items.meaning: 尽快把不愉快的事做完
items.quote: Hey, come on, let's get this over with.

items.chunk: take up too much of sb.'s time
items.meaning: 占用某人太多时间；礼貌开场
items.quote: We don't wanna take up too much of your time,

items.meaning: 直接进入正题
items.quote: so I'll get right to it.

items.meaning: 事后回头看；承认先前判断不足
items.quote: Um, I regret to inform you that with the benefit of hindsight, Mr. Ehrmantraut will be amending his original statement a tad.

items.meaning: 一点点／稍微；口语
items.quote: Mr. Ehrmantraut will be amending his original statement a tad. - A tad? - A wee bit.

items.meaning: 问心无愧地／凭良心
items.quote: He's decided that he can no longer in good conscience claim that the gun found at the scene belonged to Tuco Salamanca.

items.meaning: 谁说得准呢？；回避确定答案
items.quote: - So, whose gun was it? - Who's to say?

items.chunk: That's all I can tell you.
items.meaning: 我能说的就这些；限定信息
items.quote: The gun wasn't Salamanca's. That's all I can tell you.

items.meaning: 改口／改变先前说法
items.quote: Why are you changing your story?

items.meaning: 可能性太多了；不愿锁定解释
items.quote: I mean, the possibilities are endless.

items.meaning: 起决定性作用
items.quote: The gun makes all the difference, you know that.

items.meaning: 澄清事实、纠正先前说法
items.quote: and he will set the record straight. Categorically and unequivocally.

items.meaning: 花钱收买／使某人闭嘴
items.quote: Did he threaten you, or pay you off?

items.meaning: 利益冲突
items.quote: because conflict of interest, yadda yadda,

items.chunk: I'll spare you the gory details.
items.meaning: 血腥／难听的细节就不说了
items.quote: I'll spare you the gory details, but it was a deal and a half. Not something you forget.

items.chunk: Don't be too tough on yourself.
items.meaning: 别太苛责自己
items.quote: Don't be too tough on yourself.

items.chunk: discretion is the better part of valor
items.meaning: 谨慎比逞勇更明智；谚语
items.quote: Like they say, discretion is the better part of valour. I would've done the same thing!

items.meaning: 这次我付钱；注意前集 on me 也有“责任在我”义
items.quote: Hey, today, it's on me. No charge. You take the next one.

items.meaning: 拿到书面录用通知才算稳妥
items.quote: No. And I won't until it's rock solid. Like, offer-letter-in-hand solid.

items.meaning: 只是走个形式／例行程序
items.quote: Yeah, but that's just a formality, right?

items.meaning: 相比之下／而不是；引出对比
items.quote: As opposed to somewhere between five years and never at HHM.

items.meaning: 还挺不错；随意口语
items.quote: Not too shabby.

items.meaning: 联系一下了解近况
items.quote: No, no. Just checking in. I'll see you later, okay?

items.chunk: Would you be so kind as to…?
items.meaning: 能劳烦你……吗？；非常礼貌
items.quote: Omar, would you be so kind as to take a letter for me?

items.meaning: 怀着沉重的心情；正式辞呈套语
items.quote: Let's go with "It is with a heavy heart." Okay? "It is with a heavy heart "that I tender my resignation to Davis and Main."

items.meaning: 正式提出辞职；正式书面语
items.quote: "that I tender my resignation to Davis and Main."

items.meaning: 说得太过头／夸赞过火
items.quote: What's wrong? You think I'm laying it on too thick?

items.meaning: 严格说来／就其本身而言
items.quote: Not unhappy, per se. More like, not happy.

items.meaning: 光是附带福利就……；强调
items.quote: and it's so much to give up. I mean, the perks alone...

items.meaning: 大体上／多数情况下
items.quote: For the most part, the car's pretty sweet.

items.meaning: 已经定下、不可逆转的事
items.quote: Hmm. The bonus is a done deal. They already cut me the check. I get to keep the bonus.

items.meaning: 一个字也别说出去；要求保密
items.quote: I didn't mean that. Not a word. I...

items.meaning: 压力大得不得了；粗俗夸张口语
items.quote: I'm stressed out the wazoo. It fr..

items.chunk: more of an adjustment than I expected
items.meaning: 比预想更难适应；缓和抱怨
items.quote: To be honest, it's been more of an adjustment than I expected here at Davis and Main.

items.meaning: 一时糊涂／短暂失去判断；自我开脱
items.quote: Call it a momentary lapse of reason.

items.meaning: 当没发生过、重新来过；比喻
items.quote: Let's just rewind the tape and you know, forget this happened.

items.meaning: 我绝不说出去；保密套语
items.quote: Mum's the word. No problem.

items.meaning: 把某事说出口；听到后才意识到
items.quote: You know, sometimes, you have to say something out loud to hear how crazy it sounds.

items.chunk: It's been brought to my attention that…
items.meaning: 有人向我反映……；正式宣布问题
items.quote: Frankly, this is not a conversation I ever thought I would have in my professional career. But it's been brought to my attention that we have an ongoing situation in the washroom.

items.meaning: 持续存在的问题；委婉说法
items.quote: that we have an ongoing situation in the washroom.

items.chunk: I'm not here to shame anyone.
items.meaning: 我不是来羞辱谁的；先说明意图
items.quote: Now, I'm not here to shame anyone. Nor do I even want to know who did it, but...

items.meaning: 从现在起
items.quote: They're low-flow toilets, Jimmy. From now on, flush.

items.meaning: 温习某项知识
items.quote: Been brushing up on your contract law, haven't you?

items.meaning: 突然辞职／说走就走；口语
items.quote: but you can't just up and quit and expect to keep your bonus.

items.meaning: 省省吧／别解释了；不耐烦
items.quote: Oh, save it.

items.meaning: 不值得我花时间
items.quote: I could fight you on this, but you're not worth my time.

items.chunk: do me the favor of doing sth.
items.meaning: 劳驾你做某事；此处带讽刺
items.quote: do me the favour of not treating me like a fool for once. Tell me, how exactly did I mistreat you?

items.meaning: 给某事一个尝试／证明自己的机会
items.quote: Do you see a desk like that in here? You never gave this a chance.

items.meaning: 与环境格格不入的人；常见全句 square peg in a round hole
items.quote: A square peg.

items.meaning: 但愿那有点用；常暗示作用有限
items.quote: Fine. For whatever good that does.

items.meaning: 不管你在不在意，我还是想说……
items.quote: Hey, Cliff, for what it's worth. I think you're a good guy. For what it's worth, I think you're an asshole.

items.meaning: 快点说／别耽误太久
items.quote: Yeah, but make it quick.

items.meaning: 快说吧／别卖关子；口语
items.quote: What... What's going on? Spill it.

items.meaning: 考虑某个提议；正式
items.quote: Would you entertain a better offer?

items.meaning: 概念验证／先证明方案可行
items.quote: Consider that proof of concept.

items.meaning: 前景／上限没有限制
items.quote: Sky's the limit.

items.meaning: 全身心投入／果断投入
items.quote: So, what's stopping us? Let's jump in with both feet.

items.meaning: 有什么拦着我们？；鼓动行动
items.quote: So, what's stopping us? Let's jump in with both feet.

items.meaning: 很难说服别人的主张
items.quote: It'll be a hard sell to take them with me.

items.meaning: 大量艰辛付出
items.quote: You're talking to a guy who lived in the back of a nail salon. This is gonna be a whole lot of blood, sweat and tears. At least at the start.

items.meaning: 把希望押在自己能力上
items.quote: Yeah, but you're betting on yourself, and from where I sit, the odds are in your favour.

items.meaning: 在我看来／从我的位置看
items.quote: and from where I sit, the odds are in your favour.

items.chunk: the odds are in your favor
items.meaning: 形势对你有利、胜算较大
items.quote: and from where I sit, the odds are in your favour.

items.meaning: 这一点你无法否认；论辩回应
items.quote: You can't deny that.

items.meaning: 职位级别差不多的横向跳槽
items.quote: You deserve more than just a lateral move. Bottom line, that's what Schweikart represents.

items.meaning: 换了名字的同一类人／事；此处贬低新律所
items.quote: He's just Howard Hamlin by a different name.

items.meaning: 早就该发生／酝酿已久
items.quote: It was mutual, and a long time coming.

items.meaning: 适合的人／岗位
items.quote: That job was never the right fit for me. This is.

items.meaning: 循规蹈矩／按规则做；此处指执业风格
items.quote: Are you going to play it straight, or are you gonna be colorful? I'm gonna play it straight. Right down the line.

items.chunk: There's no point in doing sth.
items.meaning: 做某事没意义
items.quote: There's no point in me doing this if I can't be myself.

items.meaning: 以真实的自己投入某事
items.quote: But if we're gonna do this, I gotta go into it as me.

items.meaning: 你有我在／我会陪着你；此处是关系承诺，区别于“你抓到我了”
items.quote: You've got me. Just not as a law partner.

items.meaning: 房子可直接入住；房产用语
items.quote: It's move-in ready, as you can see.

items.meaning: 房子太大或负担太重；房产口语
items.quote: It's not too much house, you think?

items.meaning: 非常喜欢某物；此处指孩子喜欢游戏屋
items.quote: Kaylee will go crazy for that. You'll never get her outta there.

items.chunk: get a good vibe from sb.
items.meaning: 对某人／某处有好感觉
items.quote: Plus, I got a good vibe from him.

items.meaning: 翻来覆去说同一句话；自嘲唠叨
items.quote: I know, I'm like a broken record. But it is.

items.meaning: 不惜代价；此处安抚买房费用
items.quote: You don't worry about that. We'll make it happen. Whatever the cost.

items.meaning: 把事情促成／办成
items.quote: You don't worry about that. We'll make it happen. Whatever the cost. - Mike - Hey I'm serious. Not another thought. If you want it, it's yours.

items.meaning: 别再为此操心；安抚
items.quote: Not another thought. If you want it, it's yours.

items.meaning: 目前进展／情况怎么样？；问状态
items.quote: How are we looking?

items.meaning: 哪怕做了某事；强调程度很小
items.quote: Car looks good. Wouldn't even know you so much as scratched it.

items.meaning: 额外的／超出原本需要的
items.quote: This is over and above. No, it's okay. Really.

items.meaning: 这顿我请客；日常口语
items.quote: Come on, I'm buying.

items.meaning: 带在路上用／喝；告别场景
items.quote: Cucumber water for the road?

items.meaning: 继续向前、越走越好；告别／自励
items.quote: Onward and upward.

items.meaning: 难对付／难解决的人或事
items.quote: That guy. He's a handful, huh? Well, he can be a tough nut to crack, but he did rule in my favour.

items.meaning: 小到几乎没人知道的地方
items.quote: A tiny little town, barely on the map.

items.chunk: put a face to the name
items.meaning: 终于把名字和真人对上号
items.quote: Well thanks for coming by. Always a pleasure. - Great to put a face to the name. - Thanks.

items.meaning: 一起商量、集思广益
items.quote: We're gonna put our heads together and discuss.

items.meaning: 我有把握说……；略正式
items.quote: But I feel safe to say that you can expect to hear from us by tomorrow at the latest.

items.meaning: 后果你自己承担；不是真的葬礼
items.quote: Your funeral, dude.

items.meaning: 正好在附近；解释顺路
items.quote: - Just in the neighborhood. - Great!

items.meaning: 说话注意点／别乱说
items.quote: Hey, watch your mouth around the lady.

items.meaning: 好兆头
items.quote: Feel like it's a good omen for what's next.

items.meaning: 自己当老板
items.quote: It's time for me to be my own boss. Solo practice.

items.meaning: 某人配不上你／你比他们强
items.quote: Hey, I've said all along you're too good for those clowns.

items.meaning: 为此／为了实现刚才说的目标；正式衔接
items.quote: Good. To that end, I have a pitch for you.

items.meaning: 有个提议想向某人推介
items.quote: I have a pitch for you. Not Wexler-McGill.

items.meaning: 按我们认为合适的方式
items.quote: Both free to practice as we see fit.

items.meaning: 在同一屋檐下／同一地点
items.quote: Separate firms under one roof.

items.chunk: You do things your way, and I do them mine.
items.meaning: 你按你的方式做，我按我的方式做；并行但不干涉
items.quote: You do things your way and I do them mine.

items.meaning: 独自干／独自承担
items.quote: We'll have freedom, but we aren't each trying to go it alone. Not partners. Solo practitioners together.
